summary: Alps Group Inc, a Cayman Islands exempted foreign private issuer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K attaching a supplement to its proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting originally noticed October 8-9, 2026. The supplement postpones the EGM from October 21 to October 30, 2026, updates virtual Zoom participation details, and moves the voting deadline to 11:59 PM ET October 28, 2026. The record date remains October 5, 2026. No other changes were made. This is a routine meeting-administration filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated.
